claim: The order in which birds are listed does not change what they do.
derivation: The equations give every bird the same rules and refer to list order only to break exact ties between beacons (E6), which a single beacon cannot produce.
So reversing the list and taking a step gives the reversed result. Sums run in a different order, which changes only rounding, far below 1e-12 after one step.
Observables are symmetric in the birds and agree to the same tolerance (E12–E14).
